description: Company contact lookup from a domain: published emails and LinkedIn, X and GitHub links from the home, about, contact, team and careers pages, deduplicated, plus MX, SPF and DMARC records. Not mailbox verification. Use when an agent needs public company contact data for outreach research. $0.01 only when an email is found; a result with no email is free.
